description: This Java class, RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder, is responsible for creating renderable form elements for a web application within the Ofbiz framework. It includes methods to generate tooltips, labels, display fields, input fields (text, textarea, date/time, dropdown, etc.), hyperlinks, container elements, and form groups, often wrapping the functionality in macros. The class heavily interacts with model form definitions, context maps, and request/response objects to produce flexible, dynamic form components encapsulated as RenderableFtl objects for rendering in templates.

classes.name: RenderableFtlFormElementsBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for constructing renderable form components in OFBiz, enabling dynamic and macro-based rendering of form elements such as fields, labels, tooltips, hyperlinks, containers, and groupings, based on model definitions and contextual data.

methods.name: tooltip
methods.description: Generates a macro call for rendering a tooltip for a form field based on the context and model form field.

methods.name: asterisks
methods.description: Creates a macro call indicating whether a field is required, rendering an asterisk or similar notation.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Creates a macro call for rendering a label element, if label text is provided.

methods.name: displayField
methods.description: Builds a renderable macro call to display a form field with value, description, and styling, possibly including in-place editing features.

methods.name: textField
methods.description: Constructs a macro call for rendering a text input field, with support for patterns, validation, and Ajax features.

methods.name: textArea
methods.description: Creates a macro call for a text area element, including optional visual editor support and internationalization.

methods.name: dateTime
methods.description: Generates a macro call for date/time input elements, supporting various formats, masks, and JavaScript interaction, including dropdowns and calendar pickers.

methods.name: dateFind
methods.description: Builds a macro call for date filter fields, supporting locale-specific labels and calendar pop-ups.

methods.name: dateRangePicker
methods.description: Generates a date range picker macro call with numerous options for labels, behavior, and UI features.

methods.name: makeHyperlinkString
methods.description: Creates a hyperlinked string element or a layered/modal link based on the subHyperlink configuration.

methods.name: makeHyperlinkByType
methods.description: Constructs a hyperlink element based on specified link type, style, target, parameters, and context.

methods.name: hyperlinkMacroCall
methods.description: Builds a macro call for hyperlinks with detailed attributes such as images, tooltips, events, etc.

methods.name: containerMacroCall
methods.description: Creates a macro call to render a container element around form fields.

methods.name: fieldGroupOpen
methods.description: Generates a macro call to open a collapsible or styled field group section.

methods.name: fieldGroupClose
methods.description: Generates a macro call to close a field group section.

methods.name: dropDownField
methods.description: Builds a macro call to render a dropdown select element with options, groups, and support for multiple selections.

methods.name: populateGroupAndOptions
methods.description: Helper method to process grouped options into a list suitable for rendering.

methods.name: populateOptions
methods.description: Helper method to process individual options for a dropdown, encoding keys and descriptions, marking selections.

methods.name: createAjaxParamsFromUpdateAreas
methods.description: Generates a CSV string of AJAX update areas for dynamic form updates.

methods.name: appendToPostFormRenderableFtl
methods.description: Appends a renderable to a sequence of post-form elements in the form rendering context.

methods.name: getPostMultiFormRenderableFtl
methods.description: Retrieves the accumulated post-form renderable sequence from the context.

methods.name: setPostMultiFormRenderableFtl
methods.description: Stores a renderable sequence for post-form elements into the context.

methods.name: getWholeFormContext
methods.description: Accesses the global form rendering context from the current map.

methods.name: shouldApplyRequiredField
methods.description: Determines if a form field should be marked as required based on its model form type and required flag.

methods.name: getAjaxParamsFromTarget
methods.description: Extracts parameters from a URL string and prepares them for Ajax calls, formatted for Prototype.js.

methods.name: pathAsContentUrl
methods.description: Converts a given path into a content URL using the staticContentUrlProvider.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string value based on configuration and context, using a specified encoder.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum character length or optional length, encoding as necessary.

methods.name: applyCommonStyling
methods.description: Applies CSS class styles and alert indications to form fields based on widget style, required status, and context.
